;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2018 Ahvaz military parade attack]]
**Four unknown gunmen, wearing military uniforms, open fire during a military parade to commemorate the [[Iran–Iraq War]] in [[Ahvaz]], [[Khuzestan Province|Khuzestan]], [[Iran]], killing 25 people and wounding up to 60. Both the [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|Islamic State]] and [[Ahvaz National Resistance]] claim responsibility. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-military-attack/several-killed-as-gunmen-attack-military-parade-in-southwest-iran-idUSKCN1M2080 (Reuters)]
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**Eight children playing near a police station in the northern [[Faryab Province|Faryab]] province are killed by a [[landmine]] explosion. Six other children are also wounded. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-45611398 (BBC)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**A [[United States|U.S.]] [[airstrike]] kills 18 [[Al Shabaab (militant group)|Al Shabaab]] militants north of [[Kismayo]], [[Somalia]]. The militants were engaged in an attack on U.S. and local forces. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/somalia-airstrike-al-shabaab-1.4834718 (CBC News)]
*[[Pakistan]]’s military says security forces have raided militant hideouts, setting off a shootout that leaves seven soldiers and nine militants dead. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/7-pakistani-soldiers-9-militants-killed-in-shootout/2018/09/22/15b82a34-be8a-11e8-8243-f3ae9c99658a_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]

;Arts and culture
*[[Pope Francis's visit to the Baltic States]]
**[[Pope Francis]] arrives in [[Vilnius]], [[Lithuania]], on his visit to the Baltic States. [https://www.catholicnewsagency.com/news/pope-francis-in-vilnius-the-city-of-mercy-47018 (Catholic News Agency)]
*[[Portuguese discoveries]], [[History of Portugal]]
**Archaeologists discover a centuries-old shipwreck near the [[Portugal]] coast of [[Cascais]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2018/09/22/europe/portugal-shipwreck-discovered/index.html (CNN)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[MV Nyerere sinking|MV ''Nyerere'' sinking]]
**The death toll of the MV ''Nyerere'' sinking in [[Lake Victoria]], [[Tanzania]], rises to 207. Several people are still missing. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-45611436 (BBC)]
*The death toll of a [[cholera]] outbreak in [[Yobe]] and [[Borno State|Borno]], [[Nigeria]], rises to 97. [https://www.rappler.com/world/regions/africa/212595-nigeria-cholera-outbreak-september-2018 (Rappler)]
*[[2018 lower Puna eruption]]
**[[Hawaiʻi Volcanoes National Park]] reopens after 134 days of closure due to volcanic activity at [[Kīlauea|Kilauea]] that damaged park infrastructure. [http://mauinow.com/2018/09/27/hawaii-volcanoes-national-park-reopens-after-134-day-closure/ (Maui Now)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/hawaii-volcanoes-national-park-reopens-after-kilauea-eruption-n912256 (NBC News)]

;International relations
*[[China–Holy See relations]]
**The [[Vatican City|Vatican]] signs a provisional agreement with [[China]] on the process used to appoint bishops, a breakthrough after years of contentious negotiations on the management of Catholic leadership in the [[communist country]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/vatican-and-china-reach-provisional-deal-on-the-appointment-of-bishops/2018/09/22/8e2054e6-be59-11e8-8792-78719177250f_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]

;Science and technology
*''[[Hayabusa2]]''
**The [[Japan]]ese space agency [[JAXA]] announces that a pair of {{convert|18|cm|adj=on}} tall robots successfully landed on asteroid [[162173 Ryugu|Ryugu]]. [https://www.space.com/41912-japanese-hopping-rovers-land-on-asteroid.html (Space.com)]
